how to sound like the most
confident person in the room

1. pause before you answer

two seconds sounds thoughtful,
not lost.

2. drop "sorry, but"

start with your idea.
it deserves its place.

4. ask one good follow-up

"why did you choose that?"

5. breathe slowly before
you speak

one long breath steadies
a shaky voice.

6. always have something new
to share

i find mine in five minutes
of reading a day.
